data.description: Branded Residence | Waterfront Living | Rare Opportunity at Rashid Yachts & Marina
data.display_address: Baystar by Vida, Mina Rashid, Dubai
data.long_description: Experience waterfront luxury with this 3-bedroom apartment in Baystar by Vida at Rashid Yachts & Marina, developed by Emaar Properties. Designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, open-plan layouts, and high-quality Vida finishes, this residence captures stunning views of the marina and Dubai skyline. Residents enjoy access to world-class amenities including an infinity pool, fully equipped gyms, landscaped promenades, and direct connection to the 430+ berth superyacht marina. Perfectly located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport, this branded residence combines a premium lifestyle with strong investment potential in one of Dubai’s most exclusive waterfront communities.
data.title: 3 bedroom apartment for sale
